newsitem.title: FRANCE: Mediterranean forum meets in Algeria.
newsitem.headline: Mediterranean forum meets in Algeria.

text.p: The Mediterranean forum opened its two-day meeting in Algiers on Friday with officials from 11 countries representing states in the region, the official APS news agency said.

"The Mediterranean forum is a long term (political) project...Its discussions would cover also financial cooperation and human issues within the framework of future free trade zone association," APS said.
The meeting was attended by the foreign ministers of France, Italy, Tunisia, Egypt and Algeria while remaining countries will be represented by two secretary of states and diplomats.
